matches.title: Dimension-at-most-four modular-mismatch witness
matches.object: one real bracket-generating polarized Lie algebra (h,V) admitting some complement q with kappa_q restricted to V equal to zero but no modularly balanced complement

matches.nearest_result: arXiv:2609.04299v1 Theorem 10.5 uses modular balance as a sufficient condition, Theorem 10.7 gives kappa_q|_V=0 as the necessary first half of equation (60), and Section 10.2 Question 1 asks whether the gap is nonempty
matches.proposed_delta: produce one exact witness in the scout-imposed dimension-at-most-four search; a positive witness answers the source existence question, while a negative bounded search does not
matches.outcome: Fresh referee accepted an explicit four-dimensional real Lie-algebra witness that satisfies the necessary projected-trace condition for one complement while every complement fails modular balance. Exact symbolic verification, five claim-driven body-flow references with seven audited claim/citation pairs, a clean build, and all three rendered pages passed release audit.
